MRI RIGHT KNEE:

INDICATION:    Right knee pain for 6 weeks. Had fall 6 weeks ago. Ultrasound and revealed lateral meniscal tear. Suggest MRI for further evaluation.

PRIOR IMAGING: None available.
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

The extensor mechanisms are intact. The patellar cartilage is intact. Moderate to severe chondromalacia of the medial trochlear cartilage. The patellar soft tissues are normal.

The TT-TG interval measures 7 mm, within normal limits.

Anterior cruciate ligament fibers are intact with mucoid degenerative changes.

No significant anterior tibial translation.

Posterior cruciate, medial collateral and the remainder of the lateral collateral ligamentous complex, including the femoral lateral collateral ligament, iliotibial band, popliteus and biceps femoris tendons, are intact.

Medial meniscus posterior horn radial oblique tear.  Articular cartilage of the medial femoral condyle is intact.

Lateral meniscus is intact. Articular cartilage of the lateral femoral condyle is mildly thinned.

Trace right knee joint effusion. Small micro-Baker's cyst.

Marrow signal abnormality of the medial femoral condyle, as described above. Otherwise the remainder of the bone marrow signal appears normal. Soft tissues are normal.

INTERPRETATION: 
Moderate to severe chondromalacia of the medial trochlear cartilage with underlying reactive bone marrow edema.

Medial meniscal posterior horn oblique tear.

Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Anterior knee pain
Comparison: Right knee x-ray [DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Mild cartilage thinning at the weightbearing medial femoral condyle.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Focal high-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss at the medial patellar facet. Partial-thickness fissure at the lateral facet.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Degenerative signal of the proximal fibular collateral ligament, likely sequelae of prior injury.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis with mild peritendinous edema. No tendon tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 16 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Mild to moderate patellofemoral compartment chondrosis.
2.	Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis.

Na seriji MR presjeka desnog koljena nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala kolateralnih
ligamenata, prednjeg i stražnjeg križnog ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa i patelarnog ligamenta.
Prekid kontinuiteta tetivnih vlakana m. vastusa lateralisa pri inserciji za lateralni aspekt baze
patele na odsječku duljine do 1 cm (parcijalna ruptura tetive m. kvadricepsa).
Potpuna radijalna ruptura stražnjeg roga lateralnog meniska u području 1 cm od stražnjeg
korijena, uz posljedičnu perifernu dislokaciju korpusa meniska izvan zglobne pukotine.
Nepotpuni gubitak artikulacijske hrskavice lateralnog kondila tibije.
Koštani edem subhondralne kosti lateralnog kondila femura i tibije u srednjoj trećini.
Medijalni menisk uredne je morfologije i intenziteta signala.
Fisure i defekti pune debljine hrskavice obje fasete patele (hondromalacija 3. stupnja prema
ICRS klasifikaciji).
Ostale prikazane artikulacijske hrskavice urednih su intenziteta signala.
Izljev u koljenu. Poplitealna (Bakerova) cista promjera 4,5 cm KK.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

ΕΥΡΗΜΑΤΑ: - Εκτεταµένες οστεοαρθριτικές αλλοιώσεις εντοπιζόµενες ιδίως στο έσω µεσάρθριο διάστηµα µε ολικού πάχους απώλεια αρθρικού χόνδρου της κνήµης και του µηριαίου, εκφύλιση και υπεξάρθρηµα του έσω µηνίσκου καθώς και εκφύλιση του έξω µηνίσκου, παρουσία επιχείλιων οστεοφύτων και παρουσία υπαρθρικών κυστικών αλλοιώσεων ιδίως στην περιοχή των µεσοκονδυλίων επαρµάτων της κνήµης. - Οστεοχόνδρινο ξένο σωµα αναγνωρίζεται εντός της µεσοκονδύλιας εντοµής επί τα εκτός και οπισθίως του προσθίου χιαστού συνδέσµου στο πλαίσιο δευτεροπαθούς συνοβιακής οστεοχονδρωµάτωσης. - Στο πλαίσιο των προαναφερθέντων εκφυλιστικών αλλοιώσεων αναγνωρίζεται επίσης εκτεταµένο υπαρθρικό οστεοµυελικό οίδηµα στον έσω µηριαίο και κνηµιαίο κόνδυλο, η έκταση του οποίου θέτει την υπόνοια συνύπαρξης καταγµάτων ανεπάρκειας (subchondral insufficiency fractures - γνωστών και ως SONK). Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left knee pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Dorsal defect of the patella, an anatomic variant. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Multifocal high-grade chondral fissuring along the medial and lateral patellar facet and at the median ridge of the patella with subchondral cystic change.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 10 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Moderate patellar chondrosis with multifocal high-grade chondral fissuring.
2. No meniscal tear or ligamentous injury.

FINDINGS:

Fluid:
Small joint effusion. No Bakers cyst. Small ganglion cyst associated with the medial head gastrocnemius insertion.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
Degenerative multidirectional tear, with longitudinal horizontal tear at the junction of the body and posterior horn, and radial tear of the posterior horn. There is mild meniscal extrusion. Full-thickness chondral loss at the medial femoral condyle, with diffuse high-grade medial articular cartilage thinning. Small marginal osteophytes in keeping with mild medial compartment osteoarthrosis.
Thickening of the MCL with mild overlying edema in keeping with grade 1 injury.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
Blunting of the inner free edge of the body of the lateral meniscus in keeping with a small partial radial tear, on a background of degenerative signal changes. Mild partial-thickness chondral thinning of lateral articular cartilage.
Normal lateral collateral ligament structures. Trace of fluid within the popliteal recess.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
Mucoid degeneration of the ACL, with early ganglion cyst formation within the distal insertion. Normal PCL.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Normal extensor mechanism. Normal fat pads.
Full-thickness cartilage loss at the medial patellar articular facet with mild subchondral reactive edema.
Small marginal osteophytes in keeping with mild osteoarthrosis.

Bones:
Normal.

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

Other findings:
None

CONCLUSION:
1.Tricompartmental osteoarthrosis/chondropathy as detailed above.
2.Degenerative multidirectional medial meniscal tear with mild meniscal extrusion.
3.Small lateral meniscal partial radial tear.
